requiredChecks: PR Quality Gate and Ai Review Gate before merge
notes: Production mutation is triggered only by an eligible main push whose changed files affect the current app, Worker runtime, bindings, migrations, dependencies, or materialized UI.
Documentation, test-only, and production control-plane-only changes do not mutate the production Worker, D1, or R2.
GitHub Actions is the approval and status layer; the release implementation is the portable repository command scripts/run_cloudflare_production_release.sh.

The portable release command performs one dependency-install/build lane, Worker quick preflight, D1 migration application, R2 materialization, guarded Worker deploy, and post-deploy verification without a GitHub Artifact handoff.
The production public entrypoint is Cloudflare Worker ikimon-life-cloudflare-prod, not the legacy VPS blue/green lane.
The production Worker must not own staging.ikimon.life routes; Cloudflare staging owns staging.ikimon.life/* through ikimon-life-cloudflare-staging.
Routine production deploy must not use VPS SSH, deploy_platform_v2_blue_green.sh, or VPS_SSH_KEY.
Routine production deploy must not change DNS, custom domains, secrets, billing, provider settings, or VPS state.
R2 writes in routine deploy are limited to generated original UI HTML/static assets and materialization metadata from the exact deployed commit.
